name: ck-underwear-curvy-model
image_purpose: Lifestyle outfit post and city-apartment moodboard

prompt.project_info: Create a realistic smartphone reflection selfie in a high-rise apartment with a late-afternoon city view.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult blonde woman with a shoulder-length side-parted bob and natural warm fair skin. She wears a white ribbed sleeveless crop top and gray melange boy-short base layers with the supplied Calvin Klein waistband marking visible only as shown in the reference. She stands in side profile holding a blue-gray smartphone, with relaxed natural proportions and posture.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium knees-up framing through a glass balcony door or floor-to-ceiling window, subject slightly turned toward the reflection. Include high-rise skyline, cloudy late-afternoon or sunset sky, architectural window lines, and a blurred cart with bottles.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused natural daylight with a gentle warm golden-hour cast, subtle reflected window light, realistic skin and glass reflections, candid influencer-style atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Smartphone mirror/reflection look, eye-level perspective, medium framing, realistic fabric and skin texture, subtle grain, natural dynamic range, no beauty smoothing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A realistic smartphone reflection selfie of one approved adult blonde woman with a shoulder-length side-parted bob and natural warm fair skin in a high-rise apartment. She wears a white ribbed sleeveless crop top and gray melange boy-short base layers with the supplied Calvin Klein waistband marking visible only as shown in the reference. She stands in side profile holding a blue-gray smartphone, relaxed and confident, framed through a glass balcony door with a high-rise skyline, cloudy late-afternoon sky, architectural window lines, and a blurred cart with bottles behind her. Soft diffused daylight with a gentle golden-hour cast, realistic glass reflections, natural proportions, candid influencer-style realism, and subtle grain.
